Question: Using task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv, what was the mean water temperature (deg C) at Lake Mendota during July 2026? Reply with one number to 2 decimals.
Result: Solved (2 attempts)
Feedback received on incorrect attempts:
  * Readings aren't trustworthy unless their own quality flag is 0; drop estimated, suspect, and offline values.
Code executed:
```python
import pandas as pd
p='task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p,skiprows=1,parse_dates=['timestamp'])
x=df[(df.timestamp.dt.to_period('M')=='2026-07') & (df.water_temp_qc==0)].water_temp_C
print(len(x), x.mean(), f'{x.mean():.2f}')
```
Final output answer: 22.06

Question: Using task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv, how many hourly readings exceeded 25 deg C at Lake Mendota on July 10, 2026? Reply with one integer.
Result: Solved (1 attempt)
Code executed:
```python
import pandas as pd
p='task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p,skiprows=1,parse_dates=['timestamp'])
x=df[(df.timestamp>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-10 08:00'))&(df.timestamp<pd.Timestamp('2026-07-11 08:00'))&(df.water_temp_qc==0)&(df.water_temp_C>25)]
print(len(x))
```
